future: буду / будешь ... + infinitive

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.en: to check, to test, to verify
meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'верить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to check, to test', paired with 'проверять'.

examples.text: Вот с таким настроением и иди к Аникееву. Паяльник проверь.
examples.trans: Go to Anikeev in just that mood. Check the soldering iron.

examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

вытащить.gloss: to pull out, to get out

meanings.en: to pull out, to take out
meanings.note: вытащить из сумки = to take out of a bag

Of trouble, of prison. Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'тащить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to pull out, to get out', paired with 'вытаскивать'.

examples.text: Я буду мэром вместо него, чтобы его потом вытащить.
examples.trans: I'll be mayor instead of him, so I can get him out later.

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.
